rules.rationale: Base equation of the total structural predicate allInts; it defines the predicate on the empty ValSeq and adds no independent mathematical fact.
Recursive equation defining allInts on a nonempty ValSeq by testing the head and recurring on the strict tail.
Guarded base case of the strangeAcc mathematical summary: once the left bound has crossed the right bound, the named accumulator result is A.
Guarded singleton case defining strangeAcc when the bounds coincide by appending the sole remaining indexed value.
Guarded recursive case defining strangeAcc by appending the left and right values and recurring on the strictly smaller interval.

This simplification rule asserts a Map-deletion identity rather than defining a named summary. Stage 1 compiles VERIFICATION with the rule before every kprove run and contains no prior proof of this exact rule in a module that omits it, so it is an additional trusted mathematical fact.
